paper_gate.instruction: If the Paper MCP tools are missing or get_basic_info fails, stop and tell the user to open Paper desktop with the target file and reconnect the paper MCP server (/mcp). Do not fall back to another canvas.

font_matching.why: Most visible error. Complete before writing any HTML.

F1_identify.instruction: Start from the resolved {font}, then confirm it in the source app's font setup. Do not guess. Do not assume it matches Paper tokens.

F2_confirm.instruction: Exact family name from F1. Verify weight coverage.

F3_crosscheck.instruction: Compare the source font against Paper's font tokens (--font-body, {prefix}font*). Source wins if they differ. Note the discrepancy in the exit report.

F4_apply.warning: Paper does NOT inherit fontFamily to child Text nodes. Every Text node defaults to system-ui, sans-serif.
F4_apply.alternative: set font-family inline on every text-containing element in write_html
